topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I stood there, holding the familiar, worn teddy bear, its button eyes staring back at me, the patch on its arm a faded reminder of its past. I knew every stitch, every seam, as well as I knew my own hands. It was mine, no doubt, but finding it here, at a stranger’s yard sale, meant someone else had once claimed it, if only for a little while. I couldn’t just take it, could I? It felt like I was stealing, taking something that had perhaps become precious to someone else, even if it once belonged to me. I looked around, hoping no one noticed my indecision, my hands gripping the bear tighter as I tried to decide the right thing to do.
